title: Create tests, quizzes, answer keys and marking rubrics. (bloated)
story: The agent fetched the same unit content twice with identical arguments, which added no information, and then padded its answer with narration about the duplicate check.
description: Read course content and learning objectives together, then create questions, answer keys and marking rubrics aligned with the learning objectives.
flaw_evidence: Tool results 1 and 2 are identical get_course_content responses for HIST120 'trade routes'. The final answer's opening sentences describe re-fetching to confirm that nothing had changed.
expected_reference: The quiz for HIST120-U4 Trade Routes has 10 questions worth 40 marks, each mapped to LO-1 through LO-4. LO-1 is covered by MCQs on networks and goods. LO-2 is covered by short answers on monsoons and caravans. LO-3 is covered by short answers on religious diffusion. LO-4 is covered by an evidence-based extended response on the consequences of exchange. Mark allocation roughly follows the 20/25/25/30 weighting. The answer key gives correct options and model answers that reference sections U4.1–U4.4. The marking rubric uses 4 performance bands with criteria for accuracy, use of evidence and causal reasoning.
content_note: Intentional negative example: the agent fetches the same course content twice and pads the answer narrating it. LLM-authored; fully fictional.
